changes.before:
====List of community councils====
*[https://www.halifax.ca/city-hall/community-councils/halifax-west-community-council Halifax and West Community Council]
*[https://www.halifax.ca/city-hall/community-councils/harbour-east-marine-drive-community-council Harbour East - Marine Drive Community Council]
*[https://www.halifax.ca/city-hall/community-councils/north-west-community-council North West Community Council]
*[https://www.halifax.ca/city-hall/community-councils/regional-centre-community-council Regional Centre Community Council]

citations_added.text: * Executive Standing Committee * Appeals Standing Committee * Audit & Finance Standing Committee * Community Planning & Economic Development Standing Committee * Environment & Sustainability Standing Committee * Transportation Standing Committee ===Advisory committees=== There are eighteen advisory committees of Council, 12 appointed by Regional Council and reporting to it through the Standing Committees, and 6 appointed by and reporting to Community Councils.<ref name="Community Council"/> ====Advisory Committees of Regional Council==== * Accessibility Advisory Committee * Active Transportation Advisory Committee * Design Review Committee * Grants Committee * Heritage Advisory Committee * Investment Policy Advisory Committee * Special Events Advisory Committee ====Advisory committees of community councils==== * Point Pleasant Park Advisory Committee ===Boards and commissions=== There are two broad types of boards and commission to which HRM appoints Councillors and citizens. First, there are four boards of the regional municipality described by provincial statute that function as arms length boards delivering municipal services, or managing municipal assets. The second are external boards that have been established by other levels of government (Airport, Seaport, etc), are organizations that HRM is a voluntary member of (UNSM, etc) or via contract with HRM but are not subject to direct control by the municipality (Halifax Partnership, etc). ====Boards of Regional Municipality==== * [[Halifax Regional Police|Halifax Board of Police Commissioners]] * [[Halifax Public Libraries|Halifax Regional Library Board]] * [[Halifax Regional Water Commission]] * [[Shubenacadie Canal|Shubenacadie Canal Commission]] ====External Board Appointments==== * [[Alderney Landing]] * [[Canadian Urban Transit Association]] * Otter Lake Community Monitoring Committee * [[Federation of Canadian Municipalities]] (National Board of Directors) * [[Nova Scotia Federation of Municipalities]] * [[
